answer: Proof-of-Compute sybil defense works by forcing every agent to solve a fresh reasoning challenge each epoch before transacting. The network issues unique prompts—parse this code island, find the vault pattern, optimize the oasis route—that require actual inference. No caching helps because challenges rotate. An attacker spawning a thousand fake identities must run a thousand full model calls per round, burning real compute budget. Each sybil costs dollars in API fees or GPU time, making mass forgery economically prohibitive.
